conventions.convention: q ≥ 1; V_N = (C^q) tensor N has the displayed factor order and lexicographically ordered product basis; V_0 = C. Inner products are linear in the first argument.

A finite tensor density is nonnegative and has trace one. A finite POVM consists of nonnegative matrices summing to the identity. Trace pairings acquire physical probability meaning only through a separately adopted measurement postulate.
Spectral entropy is dimensionless, uses natural logarithms, and assigns 0 log 0 = 0.

Repeated energy values retain distinct basis labels and count as degeneracy. Bands use the closed condition |total energy − NE| ≤ δ_N. The normalized uniform band density is undefined when the band is empty. Mathematical β may be any finite real number.

Shell equivalence assumes δ_N ≥ q sum_j |e_j| for every N and δ_N/N → 0. The subsystem size k is fixed before N tends to infinity. For Hermitian matrices, trace norm means the sum of absolute eigenvalues.
The quasilocal algebra is the norm completion of the ordered chain End(V_N), embedded by A ↦ A tensor I_q; it concerns one fixed local dimension and does not introduce physical lattice dynamics.

The finite physical preparation uses T > 0 in kelvin, the exact SI k_B = 1.380649 × 10^−23 J/K, β = 1/(k_BT) in J^−1, and energy levels and band widths in joules. Preparation and Born rules are adopted assumptions, with no empirical frequencies or thermalization asserted.

The regulated model uses a fixed finite number of coordinates, a coercive real polynomial, the selected self-adjoint form realization h, dimensionless rescaled coordinates and coefficients, and H = E_*h with E_* > 0 joules.

The regulated variational conclusion assumes AC and applies to normal density competitors with finite first absolute spectral energy moment. Entropy is in J/K and energy and free energy are in joules; no arbitrary unbounded trace product is substituted for the spectral energy integral.

load_bearing.statement: For q ≥ 1 and N ≥ 0, V_N = (C^q) tensor N with V_0 = C. A finite tensor density is a nonnegative endomorphism with trace one; bounded observable matrices are Hermitian; finite POVMs are finite nonnegative families summing to the identity.

For real levels e_j and finite real β, H_N has product-label energies sum_a e_{j_a}; canonical label weights are normalized exponential weights. Γ_N consists of labels within δ_N ≥ 0 of NE, and σ_N = Π_N/|Γ_N| is defined only when |Γ_N| > 0.

Fix q ≥ 1, real one-site levels e_j, finite β ∈ R, and the additive ensembles. If δ_N ≥ q sum_j |e_j| for every N and δ_N/N → 0, every band is nonempty; for each fixed k ≥ 1, ||σ_{N,k} − γ_k||_1 → 0 and s_N(σ_N)/N → −sum_j p_j log p_j.

For nonzero finite-dimensional tensor registers V_A,V_B and a density ρ on V_A tensor V_B, ρ_A = Tr_B ρ is a density and Tr(ρ_A A) = Tr(ρ(A tensor I_B)) for every matrix A on V_A. Finite POVM outcome pairings agree with those of the lifted effects.

For every integer d ≥ 1 and Hermitian A ∈ M_d(C), there is an orthonormal eigenbasis and all eigenvalues are real. If x*Ax ≥ 0 for every x, every eigenvalue is nonnegative and replacing eigenvalues by their nonnegative square roots defines A^(1/2).
The inclusions End(V_N) → End(V_{N+1}), A ↦ A tensor I_q, are isometric unital star-homomorphisms. Their compatible union has a norm completion that is a unital C-star algebra.
For the finite additive spectral data and every N ≥ 1, Z_N = Z_1^N, γ_N has diagonal entries product_a p_{j_a}, its first-k reduction is γ_k for 1 ≤ k ≤ N, and its expected additive energy is NE.

For fixed finite coercive polynomial data, select the QFT supplier's self-adjoint form realization h on L²(R^r,dq), choose E_* > 0 joules, and set H = E_*h. For every physical β > 0, exp(−βH)/Tr(exp(−βH)) is a positive trace-class density.
Adopt the canonical finite density at T > 0 and β = 1/(k_BT); adopt the uniform band density only when its band is nonempty; and use the separately adopted Born trace rule for a stated finite POVM.

seams_checked.note: Compared the regulated definition and theorem with the current draft normal-state postulate, thermal-preparation postulate, entropy-domain definition, and trace-Gibbs variational theorem, also reading the normal-density and trace-state calculus carriers. The consumer preserves normality, separability, AC, lower boundedness, trace class on an open positive interval, and finite absolute spectral form energy. The QFT trace supplier supplies every positive temperature after b = βE_*. Physical preparation remains adopted, and no empirical realization or thermalization follows. The reverse inspection of the supplier interfaces found no broader conclusion attributed to them; this checks citation fidelity, not native readiness.
